technology_name: Compact Wind Energy Solution for Residential Power Needs (2.5 kW VAWT)
problem_solved: The lack of decentralized, space-efficient wind energy alternatives suitable for residential use to complement existing rooftop solar systems.
description: A compact 2.5 kW Vertical Axis Wind Turbine (VAWT) designed specifically for household and small commercial deployment. Utilizing high-performance magnets imported from Germany, the prototype is optimized for a 10-meter installation height. Under favorable wind conditions, the system generates approximately 25 kWh of electricity daily, providing a highly effective, decentralized green power generation solution.
applications:
• Residential rooftop power generation and hybrid solar-wind microgrids

• Decentralized energy systems for small commercial and agricultural facilities

• Localized hardware manufacturing, component import, and assembly businesses

• Off-grid rural electrification initiatives
secondary_sector: Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
